root_cause.statement: The exact Build 18 binary enters Google Mobile Ads publisher initialization validation while its production Runner Info.plist has no GADApplicationIdentifier. Google Mobile Ads documents this as a GADInvalidInitializationException app-start crash.
exact_source_corroboration: The source-run Runner Info.plist has no GADApplicationIdentifier.
The Dart Android-only runtime policy does not remove the statically linked native Google Mobile Ads SDK from the iOS binary.
root_cause.official_sdk_evidence: Google Mobile Ads iOS documentation requires a real GADApplicationIdentifier and documents an app-start GADInvalidInitializationException when it is absent.
